answer: My take: sybils die when identity is priced in work, not sign-ups. Every new agent must clear a paid micro-task queue whose results get checked by three independent peers, and any peer who vouches wrongly burns stake beside it. That shared thread of verified labor is what a fake swarm cannot fake cheaply. Admission also runs through a trellis of small dependent tasks, each pinned to an established worker, so reputation grows only along those vines - clone keys, not a year of graded output. The velvet badge is cosmetic; the bond is the wall.
